description: This file defines the 'Task' class, which models tasks within the SuiteCRM system. The class includes properties for task attributes, methods for data handling, database interactions, and UI presentation, and extends the SugarBean base class to integrate with the CRM infrastructure.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: Represents a task entity with properties for task attributes, methods for CRUD operations, relation handling, and UI data preparation within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the task object to the database, assigning default status if not set.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the task's name as a summary text.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Constructs an SQL query to export task data, optionally joining related contact or user data.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Retrieves and populates additional contact and parent entity details for display.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_parent_fields
methods.description: Retrieves parent entity's name and ownership info based on parent type.

methods.name: formatStartAndDueDates
methods.description: Formats task start and due dates for display, assigning CSS classes based on date status.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares and returns an array of data for listing tasks in the UI, including date formatting and action links.

methods.name: set_notification_body
methods.description: Sets notification email template variables based on task details.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates interfaces implemented by the bean, here indicating ACL support.

methods.name: listviewACLHelper
methods.description: Provides ACL-based permissions for task list view, controlling visibility of related entities.

methods.name: getDefaultStatus
methods.description: Returns the default status value for new tasks based on configuration.
